name: expiry_seller_v1
kind: forward paper test (no orders): every trade is decided by the rules below before its outcome exists
question: does the one effect that survived costs in 7.7 years of real NSE option prices (selling 20-delta premium one session before expiry, held to settlement) survive the real bid/ask at the minute it would be traded, and do its forward results stay consistent with that history

history.source: research branch vrp_trades.csv.gz (quantdesk/research/warehouse_research.py), NSE F&O bhavcopy closes 2019-01 to 2026-09, evidence class real_eod_approximation
history.convention: opened at the bhavcopy close of the session before expiry, each leg filled at close -/+ (0.05 + max(0.05, 0.2% of the price)), statutory fees, held to the expiry-day index close, STT 0.125% on exercised long legs
history.caveats: 40 configurations were tried in that study (deflated Sharpe of the best: 0.72, below the 0.95 bar); returns are negatively skewed (B BANKNIFTY skew -4.8); BANKNIFTY moved from weekly to monthly expiries in Nov 2024, so its forward sample is about 12 trades a year

A.legs: sell the 0.20-delta call and put, buy the 0.10-delta call and put
A.risk: defined: max loss = wider wing - credit

size: 1 lot per sleeve per underlying; P&L reported in rupees per lot

entry.when: the session whose next trading day is the underlying's nearest expiry (the expiry is the next trading day by the holiday calendar, or the chain tape recorded a chain for that expiry)
entry.snapshot: the chain tape's snapshot (runtime/intraday/data/<day>/chains/<U>_<expiry>_<HHMM>.csv) nearest 15:20 IST within 15:10-15:25; ties go to the earlier one
entry.quotes: real exchange quotes only (source kotak or nse); a modelled chain is refused
entry.strikes: deltas from the desk's own pricer on each strike's quote mid (intraday/playbook.StrikePicker), out-of-the-money side only, the strike whose |delta| is nearest the target and within 0.08 of it; a wing that lands on a short strike, a missing strike or a leg without a two-sided quote skips the trade (logged, never silently dropped)
entry.fills: sells at bid - 0.05, buys at ask + 0.05 (a tick worse than the touch)
entry.fees: statutory charges per leg from execution/costs.CostModel

exit.settlement_price: the mean of the 15:00-15:29 one-minute index closes the desk recorded on expiry day (NSE's index close is built from the last 30 minutes); fallback: Yahoo's daily close; the source is recorded with every settlement
exit.fees: STT 0.125% of intrinsic value on exercised long legs

measured_per_trade.pnl_rupees: settled P&L per lot after all fees
measured_per_trade.cost_gap_rupees: real entry credit minus the credit the history's convention would have assigned at the same snapshot (each leg's quote mid -/+ (0.05 + max(0.05, 0.2% of the mid))); negative means real quotes cost more than the history assumed
measured_per_trade.margin_estimate: A: its max loss; B: about 12% of one side's notional (rough; the broker's SPAN figure is not available offline)

rules.cost_check: per sleeve and underlying, from 6 settled trades: costs carry over when the history's mean plus the 90% lower confidence bound of the mean cost gap stays above zero; otherwise the sleeve is retired (the historical edge does not survive real quotes)
rules.consistency: from 8 settled trades: retired when z = (forward mean - history mean) / (history sd / sqrt(n)) < -1.645 (forward results inconsistent with the history at one-sided 5%)
rules.tail: B: retired on that underlying after any single loss larger than 1.5 x the history's worst; A: a loss beyond its max loss is a bug, reported as such
rules.retired_means: no new trades for that sleeve and underlying under this spec; open trades still settle
rules.no_profit_claim: the forward test alone cannot show profitability: with A NIFTY's history (mean 118, sd 2232) 26 trades give an expected t of about 0.27. What it can show quickly is whether real quotes cost what the history assumed (the cost gap varies far less than P&L) and whether forward results break from the history

eligibility.paper_account: reported, never applied automatically: sleeve A on an underlying becomes eligible for the Rs 5,00,000 paper account (sized by intraday.risk) with at least 10 settled forward trades, the cost check passed and consistency not rejected
eligibility.B: only after A has been eligible for at least 3 months on that underlying and B passes the same checks and the tail rule
eligibility.real_money: only the account owner decides; A first, never B first

changes: any change to these rules is a new spec (expiry_seller_v2) with its own ledger; this ledger is never edited
